entities.text:
High Court Of Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh
 At Jammu
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Through:
 Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice M A Chowdhary, Judge

Order 
(08.08.2025) Petitioners, through the medium of this petition, has challenged and assailed FIR No.
0002/2025 dated 07.03.2025, registered at Police Station City Jammu for commission of offences punishable under Sections 420, 120B, 467, 468, 471 IPC, qua the petitioners so as to prevent the abuse of process of law, asserting therein that the dispute raised in this petition is essentially of civil nature regarding family partnership business and that petitioner No. 3, who is alleged to have been involved in the conspiracy was not even born at the time alleged conspiracy in the years 1990-91.
Issue notice to the respondents in main petition and interim application, returnable within a period of four weeks, subject to the filing of requisites within one week.

Meanwhile, subject to objections and till next date of hearing before the Bench, if charge sheet is contemplated to be laid, same shall await the orders of this Court.
Modification/variation/ alteration on motion.
(M A CHOWDHARY) JUDGE Jammu 08.08.2025
